{{Quote|There was an accident at an Imperial Research and Prison Facility and as a result many...well, most in the area have become infected.|[[Guri]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MMR" />}}
The '''Imperial Research and Prison Facility''' was a [[Laboratory/Legends|research]] and [[Prison/Legends|prison]] installation operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the epicenter of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak on Dathomir]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I sent you to Dathomir because I knew the missing biologists were probably there. Turns out they had been secretly employed by the Empire to experiment with this super soldier virus. Now there has been an accident and it sounds like people are dying.|[[Cale Herron]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ID">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Investigate Dathomir|Lok}}</ref>}}
The Imperial Research and Prison Facility was located on the remote planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to conduct secret and dangerous scientific research during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

The facility consisted in two parts: the prison and the research center. It was organized in several buildings located in a large courtyard, large enough to land [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], and surrounded by tall defensife wall. The largest building served as the prison<ref name="SWG:IRaPF" /> and had a similar design as the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison]] located in another region of the planet.<ref name="SWG:IP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=poi|Imperial Prison|Dathomir}}</ref> Another building allowed access to the underground bunker that contained the research facility.<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Administrative Access|Dathomir}}</ref> The research center was made of several laboratories located on two underground levels.<ref name="SWG:WN">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|What Next?|Dathomir}}</ref> The deepest level was connected to a cave where lived a giant [[Undead rancor|rancor]].<ref name="SWG:GEUR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Group Event - Undead Rancor|Dathomir}}</ref>

Security personnel of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility included [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lenders Ennada]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenants]] [[Flinn Boster]], [[Arwen Zherooh]] and [[Jecht Eris]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[TK-217]], [[BT-413]], [[DS-378]], [[TK-108]], [[FR-351]],<ref name="SWG:RFL1">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Research Facility, Level 1|Dathomir}}</ref> [[GT-643]], [[KD-121]] and [[HX-138]].<ref name="SWG:FtS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find the Stormtroopers|Dathomir}}</ref> Other staff included [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Klex Fulgor]],<ref name="SWG:AA" /> prison guards [[Torkin Doha]] and [[Derin Hans]], [[Beastmaster/Legends|creature handlers]] [[Tyris Santorini]] and [[Yerkys Neir]], and maintenance worker [[Pit Cornburr]].<ref name="SWG:RFL1" />

==History==
{{Quote|We found that where the virus is most concentrated, in this case, where it is being released at the facility, is where the most dangerous undead reside.|[[Zahara Cody]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Get Inoculated|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] recovered a sample of the long-lost [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] and commissioned the [[Imperial Biological Weapons Division]] to re-engineer the virus and turn it into a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]].<ref name="DT">''[[Death Troopers]]''</ref> His objective was to use the virus to create super [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> The project was secretly carried aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']]. However, in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the virus was accidentally unleashed aboard the ''Vector'' and in the [[Imperial prison barge|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], killing and turning all of the personnel into dreadful undeads.<ref name="DT" /> After the ''Vector'' incident, the project was not canceled but relocated to the Imperial Research and Prison Facility on Dathomir.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> The Empire recruited high profile scientists from all around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to participate in the project.<ref name="SWG:ID" /> Dr. [[Griffax Jin]] served as chief virologist. Other scientists included Dr. [[Pram Dramango]], Dr. [[Stane Tritan]], Dr. [[Nomi Rhane]], Dr. [[Piodas Ray]], Dr. [[Tare Sal]], Dr. [[Ziris Enz]], [[Marpo Glenfik]], [[Skrat Horle]],<ref name="SWG:RFL1" /> and [[Tyla Gallamby]].<ref name="SWG:ID" />

[[File:Sick_troops.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A group of undead stormtroopers in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.]]

However, in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an accident happened in the research facility and the virus escaped containment. The virus killed most of the people in the area and turned them into flesh-craving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures.<ref name="SWG:MMR" /> Almost the entire the staff of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility became zombies but a small group, including TK-217, Marpo Glenfik, Dr. Pram Dramango, Dr. Stane Tritan and Dr. Nomi Rhane, survived the outbreak and barricaded themselves in a room of the research facility.<ref name="SWG:WN" /> At the surface, a small contingent of immune stormtroopers,<ref name="SWG:StT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak to Trig|Dathomir}}</ref> including GT-643, KD-121 and HX-138, established a [[Camp Epsilon|small camp]] for the survivors present in the area:<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> Inquisitor Fulgor,<ref name="SWG:AA" /> the former prisoner [[Zsu Val]],<ref name="SWG:FWEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Forward Watch, Epsilon Camp|Dathomir}}</ref> the technician [[Sogan Varga]],<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Deliver Radio|Dathomir}}</ref> and the mechanic [[Nils Cridmeen]].<ref name="SWG:SP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Shuttle Parts|Dathomir}}</ref>

In place of sterilizing the area through an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]], the Empire promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone]] around the Imperial Research and Prison Facility to contain the infection. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] dispatched [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Piett]] to recruit volunteers in order to enter the quarantine zone and obtain an original sample of the Blackwing virus in the research center. In the meantime, both the Rebel Alliance and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] managed to steal Imperial authorization for the Quarantine Zone and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Guri]] sent their own agents to find the virus before the Empire.<ref name="SWG:MMR" />

[[File:RancorZombie.png|thumb|right|200px|Spacers fighting the [[undead rancor]].]]
The spacers traveled through the Quarantine Zone and arrived safely at the Imperial Research and Prison Facility.<ref name="SWG:FtS" /> There, they obtained the support of HX-138 and Inquisitor Fulgor to get access to the research center.<ref name="SWG:AA" /> Once in the underground facility, they were attacked by the most violent and powerful undead creatures.<ref name="SWG:WN" /> They even had to fight a giant undead rancor in the depths of the Facility.<ref name="SWG:GEUR" /> Finally, they found Dr. Griffax Jin, the Imperial chief virologist, who had survived the outbreak. However, the man was infected by the virus and soon turned into a zombie and attacked the spacers. After the scientist was definitely killed, the spacers managed to get a sample of the virus in the lab.<ref name="SWG:WN" /> The spacers later encountered Dr. Nomi Rhane's group of survivor and helped them to shut down the facility ventilation in order to stop the spread of the virus outside the research center.<ref name="SWG:SV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Stupid Vents!|Dathomir}}</ref> The survivors and the spacer then used an emergency escape ladder to leave the facility. Once arriving at the surface, in the courtyard of the Imperial Research and Prison Facility, they were indeed attacked by the undeads. The spacers escorted the survivors to Camp Epsilon nearby, where a group of refugees and a functional [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] were awaiting them. The survivors from the research facility, the spacers and the refugees of Camp Epsilon eventually escaped the Quarantine Zone together in the shuttle.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escape|Dathomir}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Research and Prison Facility was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IRaPF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial Research and Prison Facility was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
